didYouKnow: Iceland's parliament, the Althing, was founded in 930.
Almost all of Iceland's electricity comes from hydropower and geothermal energy.
content.about: Iceland is an island in the North Atlantic, just south of the Arctic Circle. It sits on top of the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, so volcanoes, geysers and hot springs are everywhere. Glaciers, black-sand beaches and waterfalls cover its landscape. In winter, the northern lights often dance across its long, dark skies.

standout.text: Vatnajökull is Europe's largest glacier by volume.
